# St. Catharines Digital

Premium Web Design, Technical SEO, and Google Business Profile Optimization for service businesses in St. Catharines, Niagara, and across Ontario.

## Core Offerings

- **Website Design for Service Businesses**: Premium, mobile-first, and conversion-optimized custom websites tailored to local service companies (plumbers, HVAC, electricians, etc.).
- **Technical SEO Services**: Optimization of site speed, schema markup (JSON-LD), crawlability, and Core Web Vitals to rank #1.
- **Google Business Profile (GBP) Optimization**: Map pack setup, keyword-optimized descriptions, reviews strategy, local citations, and maps positioning.

## Key Information

- **Service Areas**: St. Catharines, Niagara Region, and all of Ontario.
- **Target Keywords**: web design st catharines, seo st catharines, local seo ontario, web design for contractors.
- **Approach**: AI-first research and copywriting combined with human engineering for premium quality, speed, and cost efficiency.
